title: Pad Thai with Shrimp
description: A wok-hot toss of soaked rice noodles, shrimp, and egg in a tamarind-and-fish-sauce glaze — balanced sour, salty, and sweet, finished with crushed peanuts and lime.

image.alt: Pad thai noodles on a dark plate with lime and cilantro, moody light

steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 20–30 minutes, until pliable but still firm. Drain.
Whisk the tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar together — this is the pad thai sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the shrimp and garlic, stir-frying 1–2 minutes until the shrimp turn pink. Push to one side.
Pour the eggs into the cleared space and scramble briefly, then mix through the shrimp.
Add the drained noodles and the sauce. Toss constantly for 2–3 minutes until the noodles soften and absorb the sauce.
Add two-thirds of the bean sprouts and the spring onions; toss for 1 more minute.
Plate topped with the remaining bean sprouts, crushed peanuts, and lime wedges to squeeze over.
note: Use fish sauce and tamarind paste labeled gluten-free — some brands add wheat-based fillers.
